name: theme-design
description: Interactive UI, theme and prototype design in the browser, driven by this Claude Code session on the subscription: /theme-design:init serves standalone HTML prototypes or your running dev server with a chat + direct-manipulation editor injected (select, move, resize, edit text, pick colours), Claude long-polls the local bridge, applies every gesture to real files (tokens.css, pages, or project source), replies in-panel and live-reloads; /theme-design:export writes tokens, pages, a design brief and optionally the project's theme file.
